prompt: Create an ornate Art Nouveau stained-glass illustration of a hamster enjoying summer vacation by the sea. Use a vertical square-ish canvas with a thin black outer border and gold inner frame, filled edge to edge with luminous jewel-toned glass panels, lead lines, gold filigree, cracked glass texture, and watercolor-like shading. Center foreground: one cute golden-brown and white hamster with glossy black eyes and tiny pink paws, sitting among leaves and holding one translucent turquoise glass bottle. Behind it on the left is one wide straw sun hat with a deep blue ribbon and bow. On the right are exactly 2 large yellow sunflowers with dark brown centers, one upper right and one mid-right. In the lower foreground are exactly 3 morning-glory flowers: one large blue flower at bottom left, one large purple flower near bottom center, and one smaller purple flower at left-middle near the hat. Background: a bright summer ocean with sparkling waves, green coastline, exactly 5 small white sailboats, and a dramatic tower of white cumulus clouds against a vivid blue sky. Add an arched stained-glass window structure around the scene with swirling gold lines, turquoise and cobalt panels, and circular moonlike glass medallions; include exactly 5 prominent round medallions around the arch: upper left, top center, upper right, lower left, and lower right. From the upper right arch, hang one blue floral glass wind chime with one long rectangular glass tag. Style should feel like a highly detailed Mucha-inspired stained-glass poster: decorative, summery, whimsical, intricate, radiant, with no text, no watermark, and no photorealism.
